title: 第8章 盖天第9章 空解
lines: 白衣男子瞳孔赤红，转过头看向周岐
"能行吗…"
他都觉得不太可能，有点语气不足，似乎只是在安慰自己
"我尽量下手轻点"周岐的回答让白衣男子一怔，苦笑不已，但是他立马正色
"大哥，来战！"瞬间白衣男子化为一道红影袭向军队前方，
话音一落，军队前方男子也化为红影二者不知去向何方
"二祖，下令吧，我已经好像听到他的惨叫了"
古邢嗜血的眼神望着周岐，似乎等这一刻很久了，众人身上的战甲也似在嘶吼一般
轰隆隆，大军出击
周岐望着眼前的大军，无奈叹气
"真是麻烦"
只见周岐抬起单手，手腕上的灰色"七"字，慢慢消失不见，转眼间变成一个青黑色的"烛"字
"这个应该适合一些"
他单手一翻
"幽烛盖天"
周岐手中突然出现一个迷你小球，凑近一看竟是缩小无数倍的盘业道界，他轻轻一握，整个盘业道界瞬间化作漆黑一片
"怎么回事，我看不见了"
"我的神识不管用了"
"法源也感知不到了"
"爹，你在哪里"
不仅仅整片战场瞬间打乱，整个道界也乱作一团
"救命，怎么什么都看不见了！"
"哪位大能现身一见，莫吓小的"
"好黑啊，还好还可以动"
"谁顶我屁股，我是男的啊！"
"难道凰仙城打来了！"
甚至不知在哪里的白衣男子跟战袍男子也停下了战斗，
"怎么回事"战袍男子立马出声询问
"看来胜负会要一些时间了"白衣终于喘了一口气
凰仙域战场
"肃静！"一道声音在战场响起，立马所有混乱声停止
"敌人的一些把戏就把你们吓到了吗！继续前进，所有人横推而过"
瞬间军队所有人恢复站位，向前直推
周岐也明白没那么容易击溃大军，毕竟这可是曾经的先锋军教出来的，当然只是曾经
他重新伸开手掌，小球已经化为漆黑之色，望向前方的大军他也不再留情
"盖天燃道"
突然一缕火光在漆黑的战场燃起，众人似乎感觉到了目标
"那是？"
二祖此刻心中已然了解，周岐绝不是能轻松拿下的，战场上任何动静都在牵动他不安的内心，他现在也只能走一步看一步，不到最后一步还不能使用最后的底牌
火光突然同时亮起，一道道尖叫声轮流响起，火光越来越多，越来越亮，古邢看清了
"父亲，他们化道了！！！"古邢惊恐的发现那些火光正是每个士兵身上的化道之火
化道之火，从道基，元神，法源，肉身，皮筋骨肉，全身上下，从里到外的燃烧自己，灰飞烟灭，连转世的机会都不会有
突然古邢看见自己的神魂里面多了一丝火苗，他立马惊恐的尖叫出来
content_en:
The man in white had red eyes and turned his head to look at Zhou Qi
"Can it be done..."
He thought it was impossible, and his tone was a bit lacking, as if he was just comforting himself.
"I'll try my best to be gentle." Zhou Qi's answer made the man in white startled and smiled bitterly, but he immediately straightened up.
"Brother, let's fight!" In an instant, the man in white turned into a red shadow and attacked the front of the army.
As soon as he finished speaking, the man in front of the army also turned into a red shadow. The two of them went nowhere.
"Second Ancestor, give the order, I already seem to hear his screams."
Gu Xing looked at Zhou Qi with bloodthirsty eyes, as if he had been waiting for this moment for a long time, and the armor on everyone seemed to be roaring.
"Kill!"
Rumble, the army attacks
Zhou Qi looked at the army in front of him and sighed helplessly.
"It's really troublesome"
I saw Zhou Qi raising one hand, and the gray word "qi" on his wrist slowly disappeared, and in the blink of an eye it turned into a blue-black word "Zhu".
"This should be more suitable"
He flipped with one hand
"The candle covers the sky"
A mini ball suddenly appeared in Zhou Qi's hand. When he got closer, he saw that it was the Panye Daojie that had been shrunk countless times. He gently held it, and the entire Panye Daojie instantly turned into darkness.
"What's going on, I can't see"
"My consciousness doesn't work anymore"
"The source of law can no longer be sensed."
"Dad, where are you?"
Not only was the entire battlefield instantly disrupted, the entire Taoist world was also in chaos.
"Help, why can't I see anything?"
"Don't be frightened when a powerful person appears."
"It's so dark, but luckily I can still move."
"Whoever touches my ass, I'm a man!"
"Could it be that Huangxian City is calling!"
Even the man in white and the man in shirt stopped fighting.
"What's going on?" the man in the shirt immediately asked.
"It seems that the victory or defeat will take some time." Bai Yi finally took a breath.
Phoenix Immortal Domain Battlefield
"Quiet!" A voice sounded on the battlefield, and all the chaos stopped immediately
"Have you been frightened by some of the enemy's tricks? Keep moving forward and push everyone past."
In an instant, everyone in the army resumed their positions and pushed forward.
Zhou Qi also understood that it would not be so easy to defeat the army. After all, this was taught by the former Pioneer Army. Of course, it was only once
He stretched out his palm again, and the small ball had turned into pitch black. He looked at the army ahead and showed no mercy.
"Gaitian Burning Way"
Suddenly a ray of fire ignited in the dark battlefield, and everyone seemed to sense the target.
"That is?"
The Second Ancestor already knew in his heart that Zhou Qi would never be easily defeated. Any movement on the battlefield would affect his uneasy heart. He could only take one step at a time, and he could not use his last trump card until the last step.
"Ah! Ah! Ah!"
The firelight suddenly lit up at the same time, and screams sounded one after another. The firelight became more and more bright, and Gu Xing could see clearly.
"Father, they have transformed into Tao!!!" Gu Xing was horrified to find that the fire was the fire of Tao transformation in each soldier.
The fire of transformation burns itself from the foundation of the Tao, the soul, the source of law, the physical body, the skin, muscles, bones, and flesh from the inside out, burning itself to ashes, and there is no chance of reincarnation.
Suddenly Gu Xing saw a trace of fire in his soul, and he immediately screamed in horror
